mapper.sql: select sii.stock_in_item_id, sii.stock_in_id, sii.input_id, ai.input_name, ai.input_sku, sii.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, sii.quantity, sii.expiry_date, sii.remarks from inv_stock_in_item sii left join agri_input ai on sii.input_id = ai.input_id and ai.del_flag = '0' left join inv_warehouse w on sii.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id and w.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert:
insert into inv_stock_in_item (stock_in_item_id, stock_in_id, input_id, warehouse_id, quantity, expiry_date, remarks, create_people, create_time, del_flag) values
(#{item.stockInItemId}, #{item.stockInId}, #{item.inputId}, #{item.warehouseId}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.expiryDate}, #{item.remarks}, #{item.createPeople}, #{item.createTime}, '0')
